verdict.rationale: Syncing with accounting software is a fair question for a payroll and finance platform like Gusto, so the axis applies. The pack shows no automatic sync of transactions or expenses with any accounting package. The General Ledger report API is a developer building block that returns JSON, and the Money Dashboard only shows cash flow inside Gusto; neither is an automatic accounting-software sync, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software
